"''Done.|Wes Janson and Wedge Antilles|}} '''Keyser Salm''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who was the younger brother to [[Horton Salm]], who also served as a pilot. After the [[Battle of Hoth|evacuation of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY]],"[[Rendezvous Point (short story)|Rendezvous Point]]" is set in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Hoth]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[3 ABY]]. As such, the events in "Rendezvous Point" must have taken place around that year. Keyser Salm was recruited by [[Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles]] and [[Lieutenant]] [[Wes Janson]] into the reformed [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]]. Janson had previously flown recon with Salm, and Janson considered him to be green, but teachable. He was assigned the [[callsign]] [[Red Two]] and flew a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] as Wes Janson's wingman in an attack on nearby [[pirate]]s that threatened the safety of their rendezvous point. The battle got three other members of the Red Squadron killed, but they were successful in driving away the pirates. In [[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' he participated at the [[Battle of Endor]]{{StoryCite|story=When Fire Marked the Sky|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi|audiobook=1}} and flew a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing]] under the [[callsign]] [[Red Two]].''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' He successfully shot down at least three [[TIE/IN interceptor|TIE Interceptors]], the first of which was responsible for the [[death]] of fellow [[squadron]] member [[Sila Kott]] ([[Red Three]]). {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The character first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], and is addressed as "Red Two" by [[Wedge Antilles]] during the Battle of Endor. He appears to be played by the same actor as [[Gray Leader]], a character identified as [[Horton Salm]] in other material. The [[2020]] short story [[Rendezvous Point (short story)|''Rendezvous Point'']], written by [[Jason Fry]] and included in ''[[From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', introduced the character Keyser Salm, the younger brother of Horton Salm. Fry intended for this character to be same "Red Two" seen in the film.{{JCFCite|url=posts/57106198|board=Literature|thread=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back|user=jasonfry|date=2020-12-22|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/rmJjZ|quote=Someone in this very thread got it shortly after the book came out. Red Two at Endor is apparently portrayed by the same guy who plays Gray Leader. So I made them brothers. A geeky little lore thing, but there was a way to address it that helped the story I wanted to tell, so why not?}} {{C|Responding to "@jasonfry so Mr. Fry, now that the book has been out over a month, care to tell us the story of one Mr. Keyser Salm?" regarding "[[Rendezvous Point (short story)|Rendezvous Point]]"}} This was later confirmed in the story "[[When Fire Marked the Sky]]" in the [[2023]] anthology ''[[From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi]]''. ==Appearances== *{{StoryCite|story=Rendezvous Point (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back|audiobook=1}} {{1stID|Keyser Salm}} *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] *{{StoryCite|story=When Fire Marked the Sky|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi|audiobook=1}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Salm, Keyser}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Red Squadron personnel]]
